cards.title: Themes
cards.text: Pick a theme for dark and one for light, from Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin Mocha and Latte, and Solarized Light, or add your own as a JSON file in the themes folder. Plugin views follow the theme.
cards.alt: Settings › Appearance with Nord as the dark theme and Solarized Light as the light theme

cards.title: Agents ask you questions
cards.text: An agent asks with pinrail ask, and its questions wait in your inbox. Pick a choice or answer in your own words, add a note to any answer, and send them back together. Turn on Sessions and questions in Settings › Labs to try it.
cards.alt: An agent session's thread: waiting questions with their choices, a note on the first answer, and the box for a comment to the agent

cards.title: Every agent session in one place
cards.text: The new Sessions page lists each agent session that asked you something or sent a review, those waiting for you first. A session opens as a thread of its questions and reviews. It comes with Sessions and questions, in Labs.
cards.alt: The Sessions page: agent sessions with what waits in each, what each holds, its project and its last activity

cards.title: See what your agents are doing
cards.text: An agent names each stage of work it starts and reports its progress with pinrail status. The stage becomes the session's title, and each status shows in the session's thread between its questions and reviews. With Sessions and questions on in Labs, update the Pinrail skill in Settings › Agents, so that your agents start reporting.
cards.alt: An agent session's thread named by its stage of work: the start of the stage, statuses before and after a question that was answered with a note, and the agent saying it has finished

cards.title: Notes with files from your agents
cards.text: An agent sends a note with pinrail status --note, in Markdown, with files such as a chart, a screenshot or a log. Images show in the note, and you can save any file. It comes with Sessions and questions, in Labs.
cards.alt: A session's thread with a note from the agent: a summary of a load test and its chart of p95 latency
